messages.en:
{07 0d 00}Whoa,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 1f 00}! You have
tons of furniture!{01 00 00 0a 00} How do
you decide where to sit?
messages.et:
{07 0d 00}Ohoo,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 1f 00}! Sul on
tonnide viisi mööblit!{01 00 00 0a 00} Kuidas
sa otsustad, kuhu istuda?

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Huh huh huh!{01 00 00 0a 00} I finally get
to see the inside of your
house,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}.

Hmm.{01 00 00 0a 00} I think my furniture
meter is filling up.

That means it's time for
me to move on to the next
house, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
Hmm.{01 00 00 0a 00} Vist saab mu
mööblimõõdik täis.

See tähendab, et on aeg
edasi liikuda järgmisse
majja, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Ahhh!{01 00 00 0a 00} I feel so at home
here. I just want to kick
back and relax...
{07 00 00}I could stay here forever.{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 14 00}But I need to go see a
friend's wares...
So I guess it's about time I
move along,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Ahhh!{01 00 00 0a 00} Tunnen end siin
nagu kodus. Tahaks lihtsalt
jalad seinale panna...
{07 00 00}Võiksin siia jäädagi.{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 14 00}Aga pean minema vaatama
sõbra kaupa...
Nii et vist on aeg
edasi liikuda,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 04 00}This room{01 00 00 0a 00} smells like
chicken, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 14 00}Hmmm.{01 00 00 0a 00} So, you like THIS
kind of furniture? {01 01 00}{07 00 00}Wow.
I didn't really expect that.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Hmmm.{01 00 00 0a 00} Nii et sulle meeldib
SELLINE mööbel? {01 01 00}{07 00 00}Vau.
Ma ei oodanud seda.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1a 00}!!
Whoa! Talk about a
collector's piece!
{07 0b 00}How much you charging,{01 00 00 05 00}
{04 02 00}?{02 00 00 ff ff}
Let's haggle.
Not for sale!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1a 00}!!
Ohoo! Räägi sa
koguja aardest!
{07 0b 00}Kui palju sa küsid,{01 00 00 05 00}
{04 02 00}?{02 00 00 ff ff}
Kauplema.
Pole müügiks!

messages.en:
{07 04 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Whoa!{01 00 00 14 00} I don't want to be
rude but {07 06 00}that's kind of a
rip-off!{01 00 00 0a 00} Drop the price!{02 00 00 ff ff}
Fine! Fine!
No way!
messages.et:
{07 04 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Ohoo!{01 00 00 14 00} Ma ei taha olla
ebaviisakas, aga {07 06 00}see on
röövimine!{01 00 00 0a 00} Lase hinda alla!{02 00 00 ff ff}
Olgu! Olgu!
Ei tule kõne alla!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}Oh, OUCH! That's so
expensive it stings.{01 00 00 0a 00} Oh, ow!
I can't even look at it!
{07 15 00}It's not like I'm filthy rich
or anything.{07 06 00} So, come on!
Drop the price already!{02 00 00 ff ff}
OK! OK!
Take it or else!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Oi, VALUS! See on nii
kallis, et kipitab.{01 00 00 0a 00} Oi, ai!
Ma ei suuda seda vaadatagi!
{07 15 00}Ma pole ju räpaselt rikas
ega midagi.{07 06 00} Nii et ole nüüd!
Lase hinda juba alla!{02 00 00 ff ff}
OLGU! OLGU!
Võta või jäta!

messages.en:
{07 15 00}Yesss!{01 00 00 0a 00} Then the number of
Bells I'll pay you is {04 0f 00}.

{07 16 00}This isn't a practical joke,
is it? {01 00 00 0a 00}I really can take it,
can't I,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}?{02 00 00 ff ff}
Yep!
Nope!
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Jessss!{01 00 00 0a 00} Siis maksan sulle
{04 0f 00} kella.

{07 16 00}See pole ju vingerpuss,
ega? {01 00 00 0a 00}Ma tõesti võin selle
võtta, eks,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}?{02 00 00 ff ff}
Jah!
Ei!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Huh huh huh!{01 00 00 0a 00} So we have a
deal then? {01 01 00}{07 0d 00}Thanks for the
{0b 02 00}{04 1a 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Hah hah haa!{01 00 00 0a 00} Nii et meil
on kokkulepe? {01 01 00}{07 0d 00}Aitäh selle
{0b 02 00}{04 1a 00} eest!

messages.en:
{07 06 00}Hey now!{01 00 00 0a 00} Why do you gotta
be such a wet blanket,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 1f 00}?!
messages.et:
{07 06 00}Kuule nüüd!{01 00 00 0a 00} Miks sa pead
olema selline tujurikkuja,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 1f 00}?!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Oh! {0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, it
looks like you can't carry
any more Bells!
{07 1b 00}Sheesh!{01 00 00 0a 00} If you're gonna open
up shop, at least get your
cash register in order!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Oh! {0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, paistab,
et sa ei jaksa rohkem
kellasid kanda!
{07 1b 00}Issand!{01 00 00 0a 00} Kui sa avad poe,
siis pane vähemalt oma
kassa korda!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Hey, {04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 14 00} {07 16 00}Your
pockets are already stuffed
full of Bells!
{07 0f 00}Must be a nice feeling.{01 00 00 14 00}
I guess our little deal is
off,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Hei, {04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 14 00} {07 16 00}Su
taskud on juba kellasid
täis!
{07 0f 00}Peab olema hea tunne.{01 00 00 14 00}
Vist jääb meie väike tehing
ära,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}.
